topic.title: Today: your calendar, reminders and lists
topic.shortdesc: The personal assistant's page: the day's calendar, reminders that push to your phone, and to-do lists. Times are UK time.

image.alt: The Today page: a quick-add box, the agenda, reminders and lists.

body.p: Use ‹ and › to look at other days, and Today to come back.
Type what you want in plain words and choose Send, for example Remind me to call the garage at 4pm or add milk to shopping. It goes to the personal assistant as a chat; Follow it opens the task.

The day's events from your Google calendars, with times, locations and which calendar they are in. Declined events are marked. No calendar yet? Connect a Google account in Accounts, then choose its Calendars.

A reminder is a to-do with a time: it sits on a list like any other to-do, and also sends a push notification when it is due. The notification has Done and Snooze 1h buttons, and so does its row here; Coming up lists later ones.

ol.li: Choose Add (or Edit on a reminder).
Write the Reminder, and set When.
Optionally set Repeats: Every day, Weekdays (Mon–Fri), Weekly on… (pick the days) or Monthly on day N. For a repeat, the date is when it starts and the time is the time of day.
Choose Save. Remove time keeps it on its list without the reminder; Delete removes the to-do and all its repeats.

body.p: Each business has one to-do list, which you and the agents share. A list is split into sections, and sections can have sections of their own (for example Accounting, with VAT inside it). Tap a business or section name to fold it away.

ul.li: Tick a to-do to mark it done, × to remove it, and type in Add to … to add one. Show done brings back ticked to-dos.
Choose ⏰ on any to-do to give it a time; it then also works as a reminder. Ticking it off ends the reminder.
Add a section with New section at the bottom of a business's list, or + Section on a section to put one inside it. Rename and Delete are on each section; deleting one also deletes what is inside it.
